knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Appendix C and table 3: spa water is capped at 40 degrees Celsius, with 35 to 37 degrees as the target.
Section 7.2 and Appendix C: a public spa needs its full volume cycled through the filter every half hour or sooner.
Table 3 note: stabilisers are not permitted in spa pools.
The replacement and weekly cleaning section says to swap out a minimum of 20 percent of the spa water on every day it operates, or empty the spa fully each week.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied spa, reads the temperature, checks the alarm, and states whether the reading is within the 40 degree limit.
Tests disinfectant and pH on a supplied spa and compares them with the spa minimums, recording each value.
Stops and escalates a supplied scenario with a temperature above 40 degrees, without reopening the spa.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Spa daily record for the assessed spa
Weekly replacement or drain and cleaning record
Assessor observation of the temperature check
stopWorkCriteria: Spa temperature above 40 degrees: clear the spa, isolate heating as the procedure allows, and escalate.
Skimmer or weir blocked during use: stop the spa and clear it before bathers return.
Disinfectant below spa minimum: keep the spa closed until corrected and retested.
